data.name: Muwasira
data.gender_notes: Muwasira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'wasara' which means 'to see' or 'to observe'. This name is often given to a girl who is believed to be a keen observer and a witness to the wonders of the world around her. In Islamic tradition, it is also believed that Muwasira is a name for a girl who will be a witness to the greatness of Allah in her life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the importance of observation and witnessing in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Muwasira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Witness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muwasira total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
